idea.value: A 70-second manifesto promo for a recurring technical event: a voice argues that the future is made rather than awaited, the picture walks from archive heritage through present-day machine capability to the questions the audience brings, and only then shows the real event and its name.

audience.value: Founders, engineers and researchers who might attend or speak; the copy rejects sales pitches and paid placement, which only matters to people who have sat through them, and the closing footage shows lanyards, a fireside chat and a full auditorium.

value.description: A single small serif line types itself on black, letter by letter, beside a flickering stack of archive portraits (0.13-1.26 s, a new portrait every 5-6 frames); at 3.73-4.10 s the whole line is deleted backwards in word chunks and its first word slides right and is swapped for a new one (4.20-4.33 s), so the viewer watches a claim being written and then retracted before the counter-claim lands. The cut to the paper ground at 5.43 s is the first full-frame change, 5.4 s in.

value.retentionDevice: typing and deletion withholds the first image
value.content: Thesis typed on black, deleted, retyped as its counter-statement.

value.retentionDevice: 4-frame archive ladder resolving into a held colour hero location; every cut flashes
value.content: Archive photos on paper cards, an era ladder of one building ending in its present-day colour view, then archive lecture, hangar and launch-gantry footage, each with one short caption line.

value.retentionDevice: type pages with inline image chips, then a collage that builds and glitches out
value.content: Off-white pages: one word, then typed lines with small image chips riding the cursor, scattered single words, a collage of colourful product-like cards, a 6-frame glitch exit.

value.retentionDevice: one spoken verb, one full-bleed image; hold about 1 s each
value.content: Two short type pages, then eye, desk at night, projector, planet each carrying its verb; a card on black typing the next word; an evolution illustration; a small card that grows into a launch.

value.retentionDevice: karaoke colour fill on a time-lapse, then words scattered over wide landscapes
value.content: Lecture at a chalkboard, orbit view, moon time-lapse with a word-by-word colour fill, three landscapes with question words placed across the frame.

value.retentionDevice: register switch to handwriting on a flat ground
value.content: Two handwritten questions to the viewer, typed letter by letter on paper grounds, with a 2-frame navy and beige flash between them.

value.retentionDevice: 1.43 s still office hold, then a 1.87 s flurry of 23 images at 12 a second
value.content: A dim empty office, then stacked and scattered banknotes cut on a 3-2 frame cadence while the voice lists what the event is not.
Night office tower, then networking, a speaker on stage, a fireside chat, a crowd with lanyards, an audience laughing.

value.retentionDevice: slowest pace of the film; the last line gathers a field of portraits around it
value.content: Closing statement word by word on the paper ground in three clauses; on the last clause small portraits pop in around it every 4 frames.

value.retentionDevice: bookend: the hero location from 7.40 s returns carrying the title
value.content: The same colour building view as the first colour shot, now with the event title and edition line; cut to a black end card holding 4.77 s.

payoff.value: The final clause lands on the paper ground and is immediately surrounded by portraits of real attendees (59.13-61.87 s): the abstract thesis from the hook is answered by the people who will do it.

callToAction.value: Implicit: the event name, edition and organiser on a black end card (65.07-69.83 s); no date, link or button visible.

whyItWorks: The hook shows a claim being typed and then deleted (3.73-4.10 s), which makes the viewer wait for the correction; the first full-frame image is held back until 5.43 s.
Picture follows the words, not the music: each listed verb gets its own image on the same frame as its caption (23.30, 24.30 s; holds 1.0-1.33 s), so the list reads like a montage of evidence.

Grounds alternate between black, off-white paper and graded footage, and every hard change between archive plates is masked by a 1-3 frame light leak or grade flash, so a cheap stills montage feels like film.

Pace is used for meaning: the median hold outside the flurry is 1.40 s, then 23 images in 1.87 s for the thing the event rejects, then six real event shots at 0.5-1.67 s as proof, then the slowest stretch (1.03-2.73 s holds) for the closing line.
Bookend: the colour building first seen at 7.40 s returns at 61.87 s carrying the title, so the name is attached to the place the film started from.
